name: NMORPG
summary: Create your character and begin an epic journey in the magic lands. Travel around the world, uncover mysteries and slay all enemies.

name: NMNE
summary: One of the scariest horror games ever. You find yourself inside your dream, which turns into one continuous nightmare.

name: NMDC
summary: Your token, character sheets, and maps are endlessly customizable so you can adapt games to fit your quests, or create your own rules from scratch. Spark adventure, foster creativity, forge friendships, and unite tabletop communities across the globe with games that are easy to play.

name: NMO: No More Operators
summary: NMO is a thrilling multiplayer (5 vs 1) game where one player, the Ox, lurks in the shadows to deceive and neutralize the Operators, while others take on the role of Operators, working independently or cooperatively to identify and eliminate the Ox hidden among them.

name: N.M.E. Battle!
summary: N.M.E. Battle! was a web game in the Kirby series that launched on the kirbykirbykirby.com website sometime in November 2002. It was a promotional game alongside Kabu Speaks for Kirby: Right Back at Ya! that tests the player's knowledge of the which Copy Ability Kirby used to defeat a certain monster in the anime. With the shutdown of Flash on December 30, 2020, this game is no longer playable as the site relied on Flash to host the website.

name: Nmnmah
summary: A short atmospheric horror game where you play a father searching for his missing son in a quiet neighborhood haunted by a wandering entity inspired by an old Saudi legend. Explore, collect keys and notes, survive encounters, and uncover the truth as the presence stalks you through the night.
